title: Add end-to-end invocation timeline and log-sample compactifier
description:
Motivation: Customers and SREs have asked for a compact, chronologically ordered view of per-invocation work stages (ingest, routing, batching, KV lookup, kernel exec, postprocess, network egress) to speed up incident triage and to attribute cost and latency to precise pipeline segments. At the same time, the observability pipeline has been suffering from high-cardinality log payloads when we attach full request contexts; this PR introduces a log-sample compactifier that keeps representative context while reducing cardinality and payload size.

What this change does (single-line summary): add a lightweight invocation timeline model, emit timeline spans at ingest and runtime boundaries, surface a timeline visualization in the telemetry UI, and add a configurable log-sample compactifier that reduces attached context while preserving keys used for debugging.

Details and rationale: The runtime already emits fine-grained spans, but they are dispersed and heavy when joined with raw request contexts. The timeline aggregates existing span events into a deterministic ordered list of named segments with duration and token counts. The compactifier performs three steps on attached request context before storage: 1) key whitelist/blacklist, 2) sketch-based value summarization for large text blobs (min-hash fingerprint + 64-byte prefix), and 3) reservoir sampling of nested arrays with deterministic seeding to make sampled context reproducible for a given invocation id. This reduces typical attached context size by ~4x in our internal traces while retaining the tokens/keys teams find useful during debugging.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc: ENG-4127 (linked) - [x] Unit tests for timeline aggregation - [x] Integration tests for compactifier sampling and size reduction - [x] Dashboard panels added (telemetry/timelines) - [x] Backwards-compatible: feature gated by runtime flag and server-side toggle - [x] Migration note included for downstream consumers

Behavioral notes: Timeline segments are emitted as a single synthetic span with attribute timeline.v1 containing an ordered list; this keeps trace cardinality low and allows rollup without new trace types. The compactifier runs on ingestion only and is reversible for stored snapshots using the invocation id + sample seed if full context retrieval is enabled via audit storage (opt-in enterprise feature).

Commit summary: - introduce telemetry/timeline aggregator and timeline proto - emit timeline span at runtime flush and after KV-cache hits - add compactifier module and unit tests - add dashboard JSON for timelines and sample size distribution - add feature flag and config knobs for sampling rate and whitelist - update docs/observability/telemetry.md

Files changed (high level): src/runtime/telemetry/timeline_aggregator.go, src/runtime/telemetry/compactifier.go, pkg/telemetry/proto/timeline.proto, web/console/pages/telemetry/timeline-panel.json, infra/helm/values.telemetry.yaml, tests/telemetry/timeline_integration_test.go, docs/observability/telemetry.md

Review & discussion (summary): See review_comments for inline threads. Key threads: memory overhead for compactifier (addressed by bounded buffers and shared pool), determinism of sampling (seed uses invocation id + shard salt), and UI layout for timeline (added compact view for narrow screens).

CI and merge: CI passed after one flaky test rerun. Merged via squash-merge to main. Release-note: Adds invocation timeline visualization and a configurable log-sample compactifier to reduce observability payload sizes without losing actionable context.

Migration: No forced migration; downstream consumers of telemetry spans will see timeline.v1 attribute when the runtime flag is enabled. Docs updated with example timeline JSON and recommended alert adjustments for segment-level latency.

Risks & mitigations: The main risk is under-sampling important context keys — mitigation: whitelist defaults include request_id, user_id, prompt_hash, and top-3 function call signatures; teams can opt to add keys via config. Performance risk mitigated via benchmarks and pooled buffers (see perf numbers in design doc).
author: Sana Kapoor
release_notes: Added invocation timeline spans (timeline.v1) and a configurable log-sample compactifier to reduce observability payload sizes and speed triage. Feature gated and disabled by default for older clusters.
commits: emit timeline span at runtime flush
implement compactifier with reservoir sampling and sketch summarizer
dashboard: timeline panel and size distribution
docs: telemetry timeline and migration notes
review_comments: Ethan Park: Can we bound the memory usage of the compactifier when multiple large contexts arrive concurrently? Suggested a shared buffer pool.
Sana Kapoor: Implemented a shared buffer pool and added a circuit-breaker to drop non-whitelisted keys if memory pressure exceeds threshold (see compactifier.go).
Marisol Aguirre: How do we ensure sampling determinism across restarts?
Sana Kapoor: Sampling seed uses invocation_id + telemetry_shard_salt persisted in config; documented in design doc.
Jonah Liu: UI looks good; please add compact collapsed view for narrow screens.
Sana Kapoor: Added collapsed timeline layout in timeline-panel.json and screenshot in docs.
Ethan Park: CI flaky test flaked once, reran and passed.
CI Bot: integration/telemetry timed out on first run; rerun successful.
Infra: Please add helm values for enabling the feature per environment.
Sana Kapoor: Added values.telemetry.yaml with feature toggle and sampling defaults.
QA: Integration test covers end-to-end timeline and compactifier size assertion.
Sana Kapoor: Addressed test flakiness by increasing timeouts and using deterministic seeds.
Security: Confirmed no PII is retained by default; compactifier masks emails/SSNs per policy.
Sana Kapoor: Added masking rules and whitelist defaults to docs.
Lead: Approved for merge after CI green and two approvals.
notes_for_release: Telemetry: invocation timeline and compactifier; opt-in via telemetry.features.timeline and telemetry.features.compactifier in helm values. Recommend adjusting segment-level alerts to avoid double-counting when timeline.v1 is enabled.
